finding.contract: Team v1.1, document 04 section 3 (QA01) and document 05 section 5 require an explanation of actual snapshot coverage reductions.
finding.cause: The coverage explanation accepted any truthy value and did not compare it with the actual previous/current ranges.

reproduction.inputs: Existing seven-file, 19-row S0; only the test manifest coverage was changed from 2020-2024 to 2020-2023.

before_fix.coverage_statement: before and after both set to old range

reproduction.initial_regression_run: 13 failed, 6 passed, 30 deselected in 0.85s before the fix. A further boolean-in-pair case was added before the final full run.

changes: Require coverage={before: ..., after: ...} with exactly those members, matching the complete previous/current coverage with JSON types preserved.
Validate the supported year/month shape before set comparisons. Booleans, malformed or duplicate months and unsupported changed dimensions cannot pass as an expansion.
Keep valid year/month expansions when the basis is unchanged; retain existing source, release, resource, change-kind and description checks.
Record the declared explanation with actual and expected coverage in the hashed file evidence.

coverage: Boolean, stale, incomplete, extra-member and incorrect before/after statements block.
Valid coverage_reduction and replacement statements pass.
Type-sensitive comparisons reject a boolean month inside an otherwise matching statement.
Month shrinkage, invalid/boolean/duplicate/nested months, changed basis and regional subsets do not auto-pass.
Valid year expansion, month expansion and month-list reordering still pass.
Blocked results retain actual, expected and declared ranges in SHA256-verified detail evidence.
tests.skip_reason: ARSIA_TEST_DSN is absent; real PostgreSQL tests need A's migrated environment.

limits: This is a local QA01 fix. Database execution, official source approval, FP1 and full-chain integration remain unverified.

Only changed temporal coverage with integer years, distinct integer months and optional basis is supported here. Other changed shapes need an agreed comparison.
